serviceDeskSetup.title: Set up your service desk
serviceDeskSetup.description: Pick the starting point closest to how your team works. It sets the stakeholders a request can be waiting on, the request types you triage into, and what you call your accounts and products — all editable afterwards.
serviceDeskSetup.changeLater: Nothing here is permanent. You can rename, reorder, add and remove all of it in Service Desk settings.

done.title: Your desk is ready
done.description: Register a shared mailbox and add your accounts and products to start taking requests.
done.withDepartments: We also created the departments the desk routes to: {departments}. Add people to them next — until a department has members, tickets waiting on it are visible to nobody.

notReady.title: This service desk isn't set up yet
notReady.description: Ask a workspace owner or admin to choose a starting point for it. Once they have, incoming requests will appear here.
